title: Too good for it, ii
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Chloe calls. Long distance. Two minutes. The strip gives her the panel she asks for.

panels.composition: The hallway phone. WOOD sitting on the floor with it, cord stretched from the wall. BARNABY in the bedroom door.

characters.pose: on the floor with the phone

balloons.text: It's a partial. It's insulting, actually.

image.prompt: a young man sitting on a hallway floor with a landline phone, the cord stretched taut from the wall, a dog in a bedroom doorway, black and white

panels.composition: The receiver. Her voice drawn as a jagged balloon with no face.

balloons.text: Partial is yes, Wood. Partial is a yes with a job attached.

image.prompt: close-up of a telephone receiver held to a young man's ear, a jagged speech balloon coming from the earpiece

panels.composition: Wood, winding the cord around his finger.

balloons.text: I have a job. I'm auditing Composition II.
(phone) That's not a job, that's a parking lot.

image.prompt: a young man on the floor winding a phone cord tightly around one finger

panels.composition: Wood, the receiver down on the floor beside him, dial tone drawn as a flat line. Barnaby has come to sit on his foot.

characters.pose: receiver on the floor beside him

balloons.text: (phone, small) Two minutes. I'm out of quarters. Go.

image.prompt: a young man sitting on a hallway floor with the phone receiver set down beside him emitting a flat dial-tone line, a small dog sitting on his foot, no words
image.notes: Her last line arrives as the call ends. Order it so the dial tone follows it.
